scope: Canonical 33-domain/247-subdomain routing crosswalk: existing governed review links, four-source candidate example pointers, plus Q1-Q3 candidate source-vetting routes. Not exhaustive of discovery universe.
interpretation: 195 subdomains have a governed-review link or REFERENCE-ONLY candidate pointer; neither implies approved coverage.
204 subdomains have any review/candidate link including rejected-only evidence; 43 have none.
52 subdomains have no governed-or-REFERENCE-ONLY pointer; nine of them have only rejected candidate records.
Governed evidence pointers may refer to rejected reviews; exact state and rights are required before recommendations.
Evidence link instances can repeat the same skill across subdomains, and they do not count unique approved packages or independent authors.
Missing links mean discovery/qualification gaps, NOT an assertion of no available procedures.
Per-domain source diversity, safety, actual task effectiveness and user benefit remain unverified.
